description:
In today's video we wing it through Falcon Bastion access, Falcon Mini bosses and Grand Master Oberon. Access is done through part of the Secret Library quest and consists of killing four mini bosses, opening some doors and killing one main boss. Little sloppy in this one, all the good spawns were taken, so we didn't have much time to get it together. 

Thank you for Watching.
